client_backends.title: Client Backends
client_backends.desc: Dedicated backend processes spawned to serve active client database connections.

query_planning.title: Query Planning
query_planning.desc: Query optimizer module producing execution plans from parsed SQL.

query_execution.title: Query Execution
query_execution.desc: Executor engine processing plan nodes and allocating work memory.

shared_buffers.title: Shared Buffers
shared_buffers.desc: Primary shared memory buffer cache storing database table and index pages.

slru_caches.title: SLRU Caches
slru_caches.desc: Simple LRU caches tracking transaction commit logs (clog, multixact, subtrans).

postmaster.title: Postmaster Process
postmaster.desc: Master supervisor process handling initialization, authentication, and process forks.

bg_workers.title: Background Workers
bg_workers.desc: Dynamic background processes executing parallel queries and background tasks.

autovacuum_workers.title: Autovacuum
autovacuum_workers.desc: Processes removing dead tuples and updating table planner statistics.

indexes_usage.title: Indexes Usage
indexes_usage.desc: Index access counters and structural health metrics (B-Tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN).

tables_usage.title: Tables Usage
tables_usage.desc: Table access metrics, sequential scan rates, and tuple mutation counters.

buffers_io.title: Buffer IO & Statistics Subsystem
buffers_io.desc: Disk I/O subsystem tracking reads, writes, and buffer pool operations (pg_stat_io).

wal.title: Write-Ahead Log (WAL)
wal.desc: Transaction logging engine ensuring ACID durability (pg_stat_wal).

logger.title: Logger Process
logger.desc: Process capturing error messages and server activity into log files.

replication.title: Replication
replication.desc: Publish-subscribe subsystem streaming decoded logical data changes.

wal_sender.title: WAL Sender Process
wal_sender.desc: Streams WAL record bytes to streaming replication standby nodes.

wal_archiver.title: WAL Archiver Process
wal_archiver.desc: Executes archive commands to store completed WAL segments in backup storage.

bg_writer.title: Background Writer
bg_writer.desc: Flushes dirty buffers to disk gradually to minimize checkpoint spikes.

checkpointer.title: Checkpointer Process
checkpointer.desc: Creates periodic checkpoints flushing dirty pages to disk (pg_stat_checkpointer).

network.title: Network Layer
network.desc: TCP/IP or Unix socket interface handling client communications.

storage.title: Storage System
storage.desc: Underlying file system and physical block storage devices.

wal_receiver.title: WAL Receiver Process
wal_receiver.desc: Receives WAL stream from primary instance on standby replicas.

recovery_process.title: Recovery Process
recovery_process.desc: Replays WAL records during crash recovery or standby replay.

data_files.title: Tables / Indexes Data Files
data_files.desc: Physical data relation files, TOAST tables, and tablespace directories.

items.name: pg_stat_ssl
items.desc: Shows SSL connection details for active client backends.

items.name: pg_stat_activity
items.desc: Active backend processes, queries, execution states, and wait events.

items.name: pg_backend_memory_contexts
items.desc: Detailed memory context allocations per backend process.

items.name: EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE
items.desc: Displays query execution plans and runtime execution metrics.

items.name: pg_stat_statements
items.desc: Tracks execution statistics of all SQL statements executed.

items.name: pg_stat_user_functions
items.desc: Execution statistics for user-defined SQL/PLpgSQL functions.

items.name: pg_prepared_xacts
items.desc: Information on prepared transactions (two-phase commit).

items.name: pg_locks
items.desc: Active lock information held or waited on by processes.

items.name: pg_stat_progress_create_index
items.desc: Real-time progress reporting for INDEX creation and REINDEX.

items.name: pg_stat_all_indexes
items.desc: Index usage statistics and index scan counters.

items.name: pg_stat_all_tables
items.desc: Table access statistics (sequential scans, tuple updates, deletes).

items.name: pg_statio_all_indexes
items.desc: Disk I/O vs buffer cache hits for index blocks.

items.name: pg_statio_all_tables
items.desc: Disk I/O vs buffer cache hits for table blocks.

items.name: pg_statio_all_sequences
items.desc: Buffer and disk I/O metrics for sequence objects.

items.desc: Returns true if WAL replay during recovery is currently paused.

items.name: pg_ls_logdir()
items.desc: Lists files inside the log directory of the PostgreSQL server.

items.name: pg_current_logfile()
items.desc: Returns path of current log file written by Logger process.

items.name: pg_replication_slots
items.desc: Status of physical and logical replication slots.

items.name: pg_stat_replication_slots
items.desc: Performance statistics and spill counters for replication slots.

items.name: pg_stat_replication
items.desc: Real-time monitoring of WAL Sender processes and replication lag.

items.name: pg_stat_subscription
items.desc: Subscriber-side metrics for logical replication subscriptions.

items.name: pg_stat_subscription_stats
items.desc: Error tracking and apply statistics for logical subscriptions.

items.name: pg_stat_wal_receiver
items.desc: Real-time status of the active WAL Receiver process.

items.name: pg_stat_archiver
items.desc: Statistics for the WAL Archiver process operations.

items.name: pg_ls_archive_statusdir()
items.desc: Lists files in pg_wal/archive_status directory.

items.name: pg_buffercache
items.desc: Inspects individual buffer headers in Shared Buffers cache.

items.name: pg_stat_wal
items.desc: Detailed WAL activity stats (records, bytes, sync times, write calls).

items.name: pg_stat_io
items.desc: Granular I/O statistics broken down by backend, target and operation.

items.name: pg_buffercache_summary()
items.desc: Fast aggregated summary of Shared Buffers usage states.

items.name: pg_buffercache_usage_counts()
items.desc: Distribution histogram of usage counts for cached blocks.

items.name: pg_stat_checkpointer
items.desc: Dedicated stats view for Checkpointer process activity.

items.name: pg_stat_recovery_prefetch
items.desc: Prefetching performance metrics during WAL recovery.

items.name: pg_shmem_allocations
items.desc: Shared memory allocations made by main processes.

items.name: pg_stat_slru
items.desc: I/O statistics for Simple LRU (SLRU) caches.

items.name: pg_stat_slru_extended
items.desc: Extended hit/miss ratios and access metrics for SLRU caches.

items.name: pg_stat_database
items.desc: Database-level metrics (commits, rollbacks, disk reads, tuple counts).

items.name: pg_stat_progress_vacuum
items.desc: Real-time progress reporting for active VACUUM operations.

items.name: pg_stat_progress_analyze
items.desc: Real-time progress reporting for active ANALYZE commands.

items.name: pg_stat_progress_repack
items.desc: Real-time progress reporting for active ANALYZE commands.

items.desc: Lists WAL log files in pg_wal directory.

items.name: pg_walfile_name()
items.desc: Converts WAL LSN position to corresponding WAL file name.

items.name: pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()
items.desc: Latest WAL LSN received and flushed by WAL Receiver.

items.name: pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()
items.desc: Latest WAL LSN replayed during startup/standby recovery.

items.name: pg_stat_bgwriter
items.desc: Activity statistics for Background Writer (and Checkpointer pre-PG17).

items.name: pg_stat_progress_basebackup
items.desc: Progress monitoring of streaming base backups.

items.name: pgstattuple
items.desc: Tuple-level bloat, dead tuple counts, and free space analysis.

items.name: pg_tablespace_size()
items.desc: Total disk space used by a tablespace.

items.name: pg_database_size()
items.desc: Total disk space occupied by a database.

items.name: pg_total_relation_size()
items.desc: Total disk space of a table (including TOAST and indexes).

items.name: pg_relation_size()
items.desc: Disk size of main table fork file.

items.name: pg_indexes_size()
items.desc: Total disk space occupied by all indexes on a table.

items.name: pg_ls_tmpdir()
items.desc: Lists temporary files generated during query execution.

items.name: pg_stat_lock
items.desc: Cluster-wide per-lock-type statistics (waits, wait time, fastpath).

items.name: pg_stat_autovacuum_scores
items.desc: Per-table autovacuum priority scores used to order autovacuum work.
